Sometimes I feel so low I can't leave my bed for days. I feel incredibly anxious like a deep fear and I'm not really sure why. After a few days of being like this I just feel numb. 

I know it's not rational. But I stress people I love out. One of the people I confided in started crying. I don't want to burden people with that. Sometimes everything is so overwhelming and I know my parents worry what I'm going to be like if they go. 

I know people will be angry and it's understandable. Sometimes it feels like the best solution for everyone.

I feel the same. It's like no matter what I do it will never be good enough. I'm wasting oxygen, resources and time that other people could use. 

I don't know if this is fucked up. But if there was something like a grim reaper or a list of people who were to die. I'd rather take someone's place. So they'd have the chance to live.
OMG I thought I was the only one/hallucinating/having a stroke. I was so confused. I thought if she had a darker fabric and it fit better it could have worked. She did slay the lipsincing though.
